caption:
"We tried ads and it didn't work."

I hear this on almost every call. Nine times out of ten, the ads weren't the problem.

What actually happened:

→ Nothing was tracked, so nobody can say which part failed
→ Leads came in and nobody followed up past the first attempt
→ The page asked for a phone number before giving a reason to hand one over
→ It ran three weeks and got cut before it had data

That's not a failed channel. That's a failed setup. Same ads, same budget, different plumbing, completely different result.

📌 Send this to the owner who got burned once and swore off ads. They probably never got a fair test.
